decisions.reason: The construction site dumper was only mentioned on the website, so commitment is low, and the earlier exit from underground vehicles shows the firm will cut vehicle lines; still, it fits the firm's construction and transport focus and there is no clear sign of failure, so it stays for now.

The inclined furniture lift line has several models and its own website page, so the firm has invested heavily and committed visibly, and it sits at the core of the firm's announced lifting direction, which favours persisting with it.

The building material lift line is a multi-model range with its own page and shares technology with the furniture lifts, and weak results can be blamed on temporary pandemic-era construction conditions, so the firm keeps it.

The truck-mounted furniture lift is visibly presented and complements the lift range, so its sunk development costs and strategic fit justify keeping it, although as a single specialised model it is somewhat more exposed than the full lines.
